definitions.explanation: A bad person; the villain in a story, or the one treated as being at fault in a situation.

examples.japanese: {悪者|わるもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やっつける。
⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{悪者|わるもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: A story always has a villain in it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{悪者|わるもの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{納得|なっとく}がいかない→納得がいかない：19533_nattokugaikanai⟧。
examples.english: I can't accept being made out to be the only bad guy.

notes:
Refers to a villain in fiction or, more loosely, the person blamed in a real situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪者|わるもの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make someone the bad guy; to scapegoat
- {悪者|わるもの}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: treating someone as the villain
- {悪者|わるもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}する→退治する：25396_taijisuru⟧: to vanquish the villain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪人|あくにん}→悪人：29116_akunin⟧: a bad or evil person — more serious, morally weighty
- ⟦{悪役|あくやく}→悪役：12675_akuyaku⟧: a villain role (in drama) — the acted part rather than a real bad person
